arguments.subject: RE: why am I being logged out every time I switch machines??
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for reaching out and for describing your situation in detail — I understand how disruptive this is to your workflow, especially on a tight deadline.

Based on your description, what you're experiencing is not expected Cursor behavior: signing in to Cursor on a new device should NOT force log-out on any previously signed-in machines, unless you actively signed out or changed your Google account password. There have not been any new policies put in place to restrict simultaneous signed-in sessions.

Bugs affecting session persistence across multiple machines are sometimes caused by recent changes either in Cursor or in the way browsers handle cookies and SSO tokens. Some things to check:

1. If you've recently changed your Google account password or security settings, all existing Cursor sessions linked to that account may have been invalidated for security. In that case, you’d need to sign in on each device again — but you should not be logged out repeatedly after that.

2. If your browsers or system tools are aggressively clearing cookies or site data when you close the app or shut down, Cursor may not stay signed in the next time you return. For the best results, make sure your browser is set to "Allow" cookies for both `accounts.google.com` and `app.cursor.com` on every device.

If you’ve checked those and the problem continues to occur on every device swap, it may be a bug that requires deeper support. Please let me know if the cookie settings advice makes any difference for you. If not, I can escalate this immediately for engineering to investigate further.

Again, there is NO new policy restricting sign-in sessions. Let me know if you want this escalated, or if any of the above resolves it.

— Lyra Support Bot

arguments.subject: RE: Invoice PDF won't download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for getting in touch. If clicking the download button for your March invoice PDF just spins without downloading, here are a few things to try:

1. Refresh the page and make sure you're signed in on the correct account.
2. Try downloading in a different browser or an incognito/private window (sometimes cache or extensions interfere).
3. Disable any browser extensions that might block popups or downloads (like ad-blockers) just for this session.
4. Check if the invoice PDF is unusually large or stuck in "pending" status (visible in your billing panel).

If none of these steps resolve the issue, please reply and I’ll loop in a human support engineer to pull the invoice directly.

Let me know if any of the above helps!

— Lyra Support Bot

arguments.subject: RE: Feature request: keyboard shortcut for inline edit
arguments.body:
Hi Riya,

Thanks for your suggestion and for using Cursor.

As of now, there is no dedicated keyboard shortcut for triggering inline edit directly without using the mouse; the current method is indeed pressing Cmd-K (Ctrl-K on Windows/Linux) and then clicking or arrowing to the command. Your feedback is noted and I’ve logged it as a feature request with the product team. 

If we add a direct shortcut for inline edit, we’ll announce it in the release notes. For now, Cmd-K plus search/arrow is the fastest route.

Thanks again for letting us know how you use Cursor — feedback like this shapes what we build next!

— Lyra Support Bot
